title: Machine learning selects metabolic biomarker genes for recurrent implantation failure
summary: LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE selected eight genes (SRD5A1, POLR3E, PPA2, PAPSS1, PRUNE, CA12, PDE6D, RBKS) from 109 metabolism-related genes in public data (70 RIF, 99 controls), AUC 0.902, and two metabolic subtypes were proposed. RT-qPCR in 10 patients versus 10 controls and a 20 versus 20 ROC cohort (AUC 0.867) supported them. Validation cohorts are small and associations only.
ai_technology: LASSO, random forest and SVM-RFE gene selection

evidence.tested: RT-qPCR in 10 RIF and 10 control endometria and an independent 20 versus 20 cohort.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
